identity.name: Pilatus PC-6 Turbo-Porter
identity.engine: Pratt & Whitney Canada PT6A-27, 550 shp, Hartzell HC-B3TN-3D three-blade
notes: The H4 index (SB 149A, 1985): MTOW 2800 kg, extended composite wingtips (span 15.87 m, not 15.2 m), enlarged dorsal fin.
Rejected: FOCA TC F 90-05 (the Marabu, Baerfuss 1972) - not this aeroplane.

sources.tcds: FOCA Type Certificate Data Sheet F 56-10, issue 7, 20 Sep 2006 (PC-6 series, the B2-H4 column) - the authority
sources.factsheet: Pilatus factsheet 'PC-6 The world's leading STOL' (performance stated for the PC-6/B2-H4, ISA)
sources.tar: CAA New Zealand Type Acceptance Report TAR 1/21B/14 Rev 1, 8 Sep 2023 (https://www.aviation.govt.nz/assets/aircraft/type-acceptance-reports/Pilatus_PC-6.pdf)

geometry.height.cond: static, on the ground (tail down): not an attitude-free figure

geometry.chord.cond: constant over the span: MAC = 1.9 m

geometry.stabSpan.cond: 16 ft 10 in; the old manual's figure 16 ft 9.5 in

geometry.propDia.cond: 99-101 in (the factsheet's 2.67 m is another propeller)

specs.power.cond: take-off and max continuous up to 43 C; 680 shp thermodynamic

specs.fuel.cond: two wing tanks at +3790 mm and a 3 gal booster tank at +5820 mm; 130 or 173 total

specs.cg.v: 3608-3722 mm at 2800 kg (32-38 % MAC); 3209-3722 mm at 1450 kg (11-38 % MAC); straight lines between

specs.datum.v: 3 m ahead of the vertical tangent to the wing leading edge

specs.level.v: T-rails on the cabin floor horizontal

specs.seatStations.cond: two singles at each; benches at 3850, 4570, 5280

perf.cruise.cond: max cruise, 125 KTAS, altitude not stated

geometry.dihedral.cond: the front view's upper surface: 10 px over 500 px; no published figure found

image.how: the Commons SVG rendered by Wikimedia at 1280 px (thumb), laid on white

architecture.why: high wing on struts; the Beaver-alike is the tailwheel bush plane, the Caravan-alike carries the PT6A
